question: Where may a stone-born or bana linga be installed within the shrine?
premises: A stone-born linga is an option
A bāṇa linga is an alternative option
The installation is in the inner sanctum on a seat
inference: A stone-born or bāṇa linga may be placed in the inner sanctum on its seat
plain_english: A stone-born linga or a bāṇa linga may be placed in the inner sanctum on its seat.
